beats.text: After the war, Hanuman brought word of victory to Sita. She was free at last. She could not speak for joy.
She was bathed, dressed in fine clothes and jewels, and brought to Rama in a palanquin.
When they met, Rama asked her to prove her purity before the world, for the sake of the people's trust.
Sita, hurt but unbroken, asked Lakshmana to build a fire. 'If my heart has never left Rama, may Agni protect me.'
She walked around Rama, folded her hands, and stepped into the fire. Everyone cried out.
Agni himself rose from the flames and returned her to Rama. Not a hair was burnt, not a flower in her garland faded. 'She is pure,' he said.
Rama took her hand. 'I knew it,' he said. 'But the world had to see it too.'
